items.title: Effect of iTBS and rTMS Combined with Robotic Rehabilitation on Ambulation and Lower Extremity Motor Function in Chronic SCI Patients.
items.summary: This single-center, single-blind RCT (n=30) found that both rTMS and iTBS combined with robotic rehabilitation improved lower-extremity motor function, SCIM III scores, and 10 MWT in chronic SCI patients, with median LEMS improvements of 4.0 and 5.0, respectively, versus 0.0 for sham, at 4-week follow-up.
items.curatedReason: 针对慢性脊髓损伤患者，iTBS 和 rTMS 结合机器人康复均能改善下肢功能，效果与假刺激有显著差异。但两种主动方案之间效果无差异，提示选择时可根据患者具体情况和可及资源来定。
items.titleZh: iTBS 和 rTMS 联合机器人康复对慢性脊髓损伤患者步态和下肢运动功能的影响
items.summaryZh: 这项单中心、单盲随机对照试验（n=30）发现，对于慢性脊髓损伤患者，经颅磁刺激（rTMS）和间歇性θ字串爆发刺激（iTBS）联合机器人康复，均能改善下肢运动功能、SCIM III 评分和 10 米步行测试表现，其中 rTMS 组和 iTBS 组的 LEMS 中位改善值分别为 4.0 和 5.0，而假刺激组为 0.0。
items.curatedReasonEn: Both iTBS and rTMS combined with robotic rehabilitation significantly improved lower extremity function in chronic SCI patients compared to sham. However, no significant differences were observed between the two active protocols, suggesting patient-specific factors and resource availability can guide selection.
items.limitation: 研究为单中心、单盲设计，且样本量较小（n=30），结果外推需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: The study was a single-center, single-blind trial with a small sample size (n=30), limiting generalizability.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Shear wave elastography for assessing lower extremity muscle stiffness after anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction: A systematic review.
items.summary: A systematic review of six studies (n=173 ACLR, n=79 controls) found that shear wave elastography (SWE) consistently detected reduced passive vastus medialis shear modulus (Hedges' g -1.10 to -1.21) and semitendinosus stiffness (g -1.29 to -1.64 after hamstring harvest) in operative limbs after ACLR, linking these deficits to quadriceps strength, knee function, and landing biomechanics.
items.curatedReason: 剪切波弹性成像（SWE）能够发现 ACLR 术后患者的肌肉特异性机械缺陷，尤其是股内侧肌僵硬度降低，这可能解释了部分力量达标患者仍存在落地僵硬或再损伤风险的原因。这提示你除了力量评估，还应关注肌肉的机械特性。
items.titleZh: 剪切波弹性成像评估前交叉韧带重建术后下肢肌肉僵硬度的系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对六项研究（173 名 ACLR 患者，79 名对照）的系统综述发现，前交叉韧带重建术后，手术肢体被持续检测出被动股内侧肌剪切模量降低（Hedges' g -1.10 至 -1.21）和半腱肌僵硬度降低（腘绳肌腱取用后 g -1.29 至 -1.64），这些缺陷与股四头肌力量、膝关节功能和落地生物力学相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: Shear wave elastography (SWE) reveals muscle-specific mechanical deficits after ACLR, particularly reduced vastus medialis stiffness, which may explain why some strength-benchmark athletes still land stiffly or face re-injury risk. This suggests you should consider muscle mechanical properties beyond strength assessments.
items.limitation: 该系统综述纳入的六项研究质量从差到好不等，且缺乏标准化协议和对关键肌肉区域的采样，限制了 SWE 在康复指导中的即时应用。
items.limitationEn: The systematic review included six studies of varying quality (poor to good), and a lack of standardized protocols and sampling of clinically relevant muscle regions limits the immediate application of SWE in rehabilitation guidance.

items.title: Barriers and facilitators of decision-making in home-based rehabilitation exercise among older adults following total knee arthroplasty: A qualitative study.
items.summary: A qualitative study of 21 older adults post-total knee arthroplasty in China identified three themes and 10 subthemes regarding decision-making for home-based rehabilitation exercises, highlighting impulsive avoidance responses (e.g., pain, fear) as barriers and rational adherence (e.g., perceived threat of poor prognosis, goal-directed willpower) as facilitators.
items.curatedReason: 全膝关节置换术（TKA）后居家康复依从性受情绪和认知冲突影响。在指导老年患者时，你不仅要关注疼痛管理，还要通过个体化目标设定和积极的文化框架来增强他们的内源性依从性，并争取家庭支持。
items.titleZh: 全膝关节置换术后老年患者居家康复锻炼决策的障碍与促进因素：一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对中国 21 名全膝关节置换术后老年患者进行的定性研究，确定了居家康复锻炼决策的三个主题和十个亚主题，突出了冲动性回避反应（如疼痛、恐惧）为障碍，而理性坚持（如对预后不良的感知威胁、目标导向的意志力）为促进因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: Adherence to home-based rehabilitation after TKA in older adults is influenced by emotional and cognitive conflicts. When guiding these patients, you should focus not only on pain management but also enhance intrinsic adherence through individualized goal setting and positive cultural framing, while also securing family support.
items.limitation: 这是一项定性研究，样本量较小（21 名参与者），结果的普适性有限，且研究在中国进行，文化背景可能影响发现。
items.limitationEn: This was a qualitative study with a small sample size (21 participants), limiting generalizability, and conducted in China, where cultural context may influence findings.

items.title: Effect of Short-Rest Interval versus Traditional Multiple-Set Resistance Training Combined with Endurance Training in Patients with Cardiovascular Disease: A Randomized Clinical Trial.
items.summary: This RCT (n=71) comparing short-rest interval (3/7 RT) and traditional multiple-set (3×9 RT) resistance training combined with endurance training in cardiac rehab patients found similar improvements in VO₂peak, 30-s sit-to-stand, and total lean mass. However, 3/7 RT resulted in greater improvements in quadriceps isokinetic strength (+23±20 N·m vs. +11±22 N·m; P=0.022).
items.curatedReason: 在心脏康复中，短休息间歇（3/7 RT）和传统多组（3x9 RT）抗阻训练在改善 VO₂peak、坐站能力和去脂体重方面效果相似。如果你的患者需要优先提升股四头肌等速力量，短休息间歇可能更有效，否则两种方法都可考虑。
items.titleZh: 短休息间歇与传统多组抗阻训练结合耐力训练对心血管疾病患者的影响：一项随机临床试验
items.summaryZh: 这项随机临床试验（n=71）比较了短休息间歇（3/7 RT）和传统多组（3×9 RT）抗阻训练与耐力训练相结合对心血管疾病患者心脏康复的影响。结果显示，两组在 VO₂peak、30 秒坐站测试和总去脂体重方面改善相似，但 3/7 RT 在股四头肌等速力量方面改善更显著（+23±20 N·m vs. +11±22 N·m；P=0.022）。
items.curatedReasonEn: In cardiac rehabilitation, short-rest interval (3/7 RT) and traditional multiple-set (3x9 RT) resistance training show similar efficacy in improving VO₂peak, sit-to-stand performance, and lean mass. If your patient prioritizes isokinetic quadriceps strength, short-rest might be more effective; otherwise, both modalities are viable.
items.limitation: 研究样本量相对有限（71 名参与者），且随访期较短（12 周），长期效果和更广泛人群的适用性尚不明确。
items.limitationEn: The study had a relatively limited sample size (71 participants) and a short follow-up period (12 weeks), so long-term effects and applicability to a broader population remain unclear.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Burden of fall-related injury and its predictors among stroke survivors attending comprehensive specialized hospitals in the Amhara Regional State, Ethiopia, 2024: A multicenter prospective study.
items.summary: A multicenter cross-sectional study in Ethiopia (N=269) found the prevalence of fall-related injury among stroke survivors to be 79.9% (95% CI: 75.1-84.4). Age >65, rural residence, and injuries during walking and turning were significant predictors.
items.curatedReason: 这项多中心观察研究揭示了埃塞俄比亚卒中幸存者跌倒相关损伤的高发生率（79.9%），并指出了高龄、农村居住和步行/转弯时的活动是主要预测因素。临床实践中，你需要特别关注这些高风险群体，加强跌倒风险评估和预防干预，尤其在患者进行步行和转弯活动时。
items.titleZh: 2024年埃塞俄比亚阿姆哈拉州卒中幸存者跌倒相关损伤负担及其预测因素：一项多中心前瞻性研究
items.summaryZh: 埃塞俄比亚一项纳入269名卒中幸存者的多中心横断面研究发现，跌倒相关损伤的发生率为79.9% (95% CI: 75.1-84.4)。年龄超过65岁、农村居住以及在步行和转弯时发生损伤是显著的预测因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: This multicenter observational study reveals a high incidence of fall-related injuries (79.9%) among stroke survivors in Ethiopia and identifies older age, rural residence, and activities like walking and turning as key predictors. In clinical practice, you should pay special attention to these high-risk groups, enhancing fall risk assessment and prevention interventions, especially during ambulation and turning activities.
items.limitation: 研究为横断面设计，无法确立因果关系，且数据来自埃塞俄比亚的特定医院，结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: The study's cross-sectional design prevents causal inference, and data from specific hospitals in Ethiopia limit the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Recent highlights in pulmonary rehabilitation research.
items.summary: This narrative review summarizes pulmonary rehabilitation research between January 2021 and May 2026, highlighting expanded scope beyond stable COPD to various chronic respiratory diseases, alternative PR models, and economic benefits, while noting ongoing challenges in access and long-term maintenance.
items.curatedReason: 这篇综述总结了肺康复研究的最新进展，尤其强调了其在稳定期COPD之外的广泛适用性（如ILD、肺动脉高压、肺癌）。它提示你，在评估心肺功能受损患者时，应更积极地考虑将肺康复纳入治疗方案，并探索中心化以外的多种交付模式。
items.titleZh: 肺康复研究的最新亮点
items.summaryZh: 这篇叙述性综述总结了2021年1月至2026年5月期间的肺康复研究，强调其范围已扩展到稳定期慢阻肺以外的多种慢性呼吸系统疾病，并探讨了替代康复模式和经济效益，同时指出了长期维持和可及性方面的挑战。
items.curatedReasonEn: This narrative review highlights recent advances in pulmonary rehabilitation (PR) research, emphasizing its expanded applicability beyond stable COPD to conditions like ILD, pulmonary hypertension, and lung cancer. It suggests you should more actively consider PR in treatment plans for patients with cardiopulmonary impairments and explore diverse delivery models beyond center-based programs.

items.title: Short term effectiveness of dry needling and instrument assisted soft tissue mobilization in knee osteoarthritis patients - a randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (N=34) comparing dry needling (DN), Instrument Assisted Soft Tissue Mobilization (IASTM), and conventional treatment (CT) for knee osteoarthritis found DN superior in reducing pain and improving function and ROM at 4 and 6 weeks, followed by IASTM and CT.
items.curatedReason: 对于膝骨关节炎（KOA）的短期管理，这项小型RCT（N=34）提示干针（DN）在改善疼痛、功能和ROM方面可能优于IASTM和常规治疗。在资源允许的情况下，面对KOA患者，你可以考虑在最初4-6周内将干针作为首选干预，IASTM次之。
items.titleZh: 干针和器械辅助软组织松动术对膝骨关节炎患者的短期疗效——一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（N=34）对比了干针（DN）、器械辅助软组织松动术（IASTM）和常规治疗（CT）对膝骨关节炎的疗效，结果显示DN在4周和6周时在减轻疼痛、改善功能和活动度方面优于IASTM和CT，IASTM次之。
items.curatedReasonEn: For short-term management of knee osteoarthritis (KOA), this small RCT (N=34) suggests that dry needling (DN) may be superior to IASTM and conventional treatment in improving pain, function, and ROM. When resources permit, you might consider prioritizing DN as an initial intervention for KOA patients during the first 4-6 weeks, with IASTM as a secondary option.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量较小（N=34），随访时间仅为6周，限制了结果的长期有效性和普遍性。
items.limitationEn: The study has a small sample size (N=34) and a follow-up period of only 6 weeks, limiting the long-term validity and generalizability of the results.
items.journal: The Journal of manual & manipulative therapy

items.title: Appraisal of Clinical Practice Guideline: physical therapy management of children with developmental coordination disorder.
items.summary: This article provides an appraisal of a clinical practice guideline concerning the physical therapy management of children diagnosed with developmental coordination disorder (DCD).
items.curatedReason: 你需要知道，这份针对DCD儿童物理治疗的临床实践指南（CPG）质量如何，以及它的推荐强度。这份评估能帮你理清DCD管理中的哪些建议有坚实证据支持，哪些还不足，从而更精准地应用治疗策略。
items.titleZh: 临床实践指南评估：发育性协调障碍儿童的物理治疗管理
items.summaryZh: 本文对一份关于发育性协调障碍（DCD）儿童物理治疗管理的临床实践指南进行了评估。
items.curatedReasonEn: You need to know the quality of this clinical practice guideline (CPG) for physical therapy management of children with DCD, and the strength of its recommendations. This appraisal helps you discern which DCD management strategies are evidence-based and which are not, allowing for more precise application of treatment.

items.title: A Return to Performance Continuum for Football (Soccer) Players After ACL Reconstruction: Bridging Rehabilitation, Return to Play and Sustained Performance.
items.summary: This paper outlines a staged return-to-performance continuum for football players after ACL reconstruction, comprising structured on-field rehabilitation, return to team training, return to competitive match play, and sustained performance, underpinned by four interdependent pillars.
items.curatedReason: 在ACL重建术后，你应该参考这份分阶段、具体的指南来帮助足球运动员重返赛场并维持高水平表现。它强调了足球专项的运动质量、技战术再训练、体能再调节和爆发力恢复，填补了从重返运动到持续表现之间的空白。
items.titleZh: 足球运动员 ACL 重建术后的重返表现连续体：连接康复、重返赛场与持续表现
items.summaryZh: 本文为 ACL 重建术后的足球运动员提供了一个分阶段的重返表现连续体，涵盖结构化场上康复、重返团队训练、重返比赛以及早期和持续的表现维持，并由四个相互依赖的支柱支撑。
items.curatedReasonEn: For football players post-ACL reconstruction, you should use this staged, specific framework for returning to and sustaining high-level performance. It emphasizes sport-specific movement quality, technical/tactical retraining, physical reconditioning, and explosive neuromuscular performance, bridging the gap between return-to-sport and sustained performance.
items.limitation: 这是一篇专家观点和概念性框架，而非基于实验数据的研究。
items.limitationEn: This is an expert opinion and conceptual framework, not a study based on experimental data.

items.title: Calf Injuries: An Anatomy-Based Approach to Diagnosis, Management and Return to Sport.
items.summary: This review provides an anatomy-based approach to calf injuries, emphasizing refined anatomical characterization for diagnosis, management, and return-to-sport decisions, while highlighting limitations in evidence linking specific patterns to prognosis.
items.curatedReason: 小腿损伤的诊断和管理正从单纯的肌肉损伤转向更精细的肌腱连接结构识别。这份综述强化了功能导向的渐进性负荷原则，并明确指出重返运动是一个多因素决策，而非单一影像学或时间线。
items.titleZh: 小腿损伤：基于解剖学的诊断、管理与重返运动方法
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述提供了一种基于解剖学的小腿损伤处理方法，强调了精细的解剖学特征对诊断、管理和重返运动决策的重要性，并指出了将特定模式与预后关联的证据局限性。
items.curatedReasonEn: Calf injury diagnosis and management are shifting from simple muscle injury to more precise myoconnective structure identification. This review reinforces function-led progressive loading and clarifies that return-to-sport is a multifactorial decision, not solely based on imaging or timelines.
items.limitation: 目前的证据多为观察性研究，缺乏经过验证的特定小腿康复或重返运动标准。
items.limitationEn: Current evidence is largely observational, and validated calf-specific rehabilitation or return-to-sport criteria are lacking.

items.title: Repeated subgroup partitions preclude factor-specific inference for vagus nerve stimulation after stroke.
items.summary: A commentary suggests that repeated subgroup partitions in research on vagus nerve stimulation after stroke may hinder factor-specific inference.
items.curatedReason: 关于卒中后迷走神经刺激（VNS）的研究，该述评指出，重复的亚组划分可能会导致对因子特异性推断的混淆。在评估 VNS 这类复杂干预时，警惕过度解读或泛化特定亚组结果。
items.titleZh: 重复的亚组划分妨碍了卒中后迷走神经刺激因子特异性推断
items.summaryZh: 一项述评指出，卒中后迷走神经刺激（VNS）研究中重复的亚组划分，可能会妨碍对特定因子推断的有效性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary highlights that repeated subgroup partitions in vagus nerve stimulation (VNS) research post-stroke can preclude factor-specific inference. Be cautious of over-interpreting or over-generalizing findings from specific subgroups when evaluating complex interventions like VNS.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

related.title: Response to the Letter to the Editor: "Repeated subgroup partitions preclude factor-specific inference for vagus nerve stimulation after stroke"

items.title: The Role of Psychosocial Factors in Returning to Physical Activity and Sport Among Female Football Players After Anterior Cruciate Ligament Injury: A Scoping Review
items.summary: A scoping review identified psychosocial factors influencing return to physical activity and sport among female football players after ACL injury. Uncertainty, fear, lack of confidence, and poor social support were perceived barriers, while confidence, motivation, strong social support, and athletic identity were facilitators.
items.curatedReason: 对 ACL 损伤后女性足球运动员，重返运动不能只盯着膝盖。这份综述提示，你需要主动评估她们的恐惧、不确定性和社会支持情况，因为这些心理社会因素与重返运动的成功与否密切相关。别忘了，除了体能，自信心和强烈的运动员身份认同也是关键。
items.titleZh: 心理社会因素在女性足球运动员前交叉韧带损伤后重返体育活动和运动中的作用：一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项范围综述识别了前交叉韧带（ACL）损伤后女性足球运动员重返体育活动和运动的心理社会因素。不确定性、恐惧、缺乏信心和较差的社会支持被认为是障碍，而信心、动机、强大的社会支持和运动员身份是促进因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: For female football players post-ACL injury, return to sport isn't just about the knee. This review suggests you must actively assess their fear, uncertainty, and social support, as these psychosocial factors are strongly linked to successful return to sport. Remember, beyond physical readiness, confidence and a strong athletic identity are also key.
items.limitation: 纳入研究数量有限（7项），且异质性高，限制了结果的综合强度和可推广性。
items.limitationEn: The limited number of included studies (7) and their heterogeneity restrict the overall strength and generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Adherence to home-based exercise therapy in adults with non-specific chronic low back pain: a cross-sectional study of 491 participants of the ComPaRE cLBP e-cohort (ADHERE II).
items.summary: A cross-sectional study of 491 adults with non-specific chronic low back pain found that 45% were adherent to home-based exercise therapy. Higher levels of physical activity before cLBP onset, lower intensity of cLBP, and lower burden of treatment were associated with higher adherence, while supervision showed no significant influence.
items.curatedReason: 针对慢性腰痛患者，居家运动依从性是一个长期挑战。本研究发现监督模式对依从性无显著影响，但运动前活跃度、腰痛强度和治疗负担是关键预测因子。据此调整你对患者的教育和支持策略，尤其要关注那些依从性可能较低的患者群体。
items.titleZh: 非特异性慢性腰痛成人居家运动治疗依从性：ComPaRE cLBP 电子队列的横断面研究（ADHERE II）
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 491 名非特异性慢性腰痛成年人的横断面研究发现，45% 的患者居家运动治疗依从性良好。腰痛发作前较高的体力活动水平、较低的腰痛强度和较低的治疗负担与较高的依从性相关，而监督对依从性没有显著影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: Adherence to home-based exercise remains a long-standing challenge for patients with chronic low back pain. This study found no significant influence of supervision on adherence, but pre-onset physical activity, pain intensity, and treatment burden were key predictors. Adjust your patient education and support strategies accordingly, particularly for those at higher risk of non-adherence.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面设计，无法建立因果关系，且依从性测量依赖自我报告。
items.limitationEn: This cross-sectional study cannot establish causality, and adherence measurement relied on self-report.
items.journal: European spine journal : official publication of the European Spine Society, the European Spinal Deformity Society, and the European Section of the Cervical Spine Research Society

items.title:
Physiological determinants of endurance capacity in individuals with cerebral palsy: a narrative review
							| Journal of Rehabilitation Medicine
items.summary: A narrative review synthesized evidence on physiological determinants of endurance capacity in individuals with cerebral palsy, highlighting reduced cardiorespiratory fitness, autonomic dysregulation, restrictive ventilatory patterns, high energetic demands, and skeletal muscle alterations as key limiting factors. Impairments are more pronounced with greater functional limitations.
items.curatedReason: 脑瘫患者的耐力训练，不应简单照搬常规方案。这篇综述提醒我们，他们的心肺功能、呼吸模式、能量消耗及肌肉都存在显著改变，且功能限制越严重，这些障碍越明显。在设计康复计划时，必须针对性地考虑这些生理限制，才能真正提升他们的耐力能力。
items.titleZh: 脑瘫个体耐力能力的生理决定因素：一项叙述性综述
items.summaryZh: 一篇叙述性综述总结了脑瘫患者耐力能力的生理决定因素，强调心肺功能下降、自主神经功能紊乱、限制性通气模式、高能量需求和骨骼肌改变是主要限制因素。功能障碍越严重的个体，其耐力受损越显著。
items.curatedReasonEn: Endurance training for individuals with cerebral palsy shouldn't simply mimic standard protocols. This review highlights that their cardiorespiratory fitness, ventilatory patterns, energetic demands, and skeletal muscle are significantly altered, with impairments worsening with greater functional limitations. When designing rehabilitation plans, you must specifically account for these physiological limitations to genuinely improve their endurance capacity.
items.limitation: 作为一篇叙述性综述，其证据综合方法不如系统综述严谨，可能存在选择偏倚。
items.limitationEn: As a narrative review, its evidence synthesis methods are less rigorous than a systematic review, potentially introducing selection bias.

items.title: Paired cerebrospinal fluid metabolomic changes across repeated anodal transcranial direct current stimulation in Parkinson’s disease: an exploratory within-subject study
items.summary: An exploratory within-subject study of 14 Parkinson's disease patients receiving repeated anodal tDCS identified short-term clinical improvements (UPDRS-III, NMSS-K, MoCA-K) and specific cerebrospinal fluid metabolomic changes, including increases in purine- and tyrosine/levodopa-related metabolites and alterations in non-polar lipids. The study lacked a sham control.
items.curatedReason: 这项探索性研究首次提示帕金森病患者重复经颅直流电刺激（tDCS）可能引起的脑脊液代谢物变化。虽然缺乏对照组，不能确证疗效，但它为未来设计更大规模的随机对照试验提供了关键的可行性数据和潜在的生物标志物靶点，这有助于你跟进非侵入性脑刺激疗法的进展。
items.titleZh: 帕金森病重复阳极经颅直流电刺激前后脑脊液代谢组学变化：一项探索性受试者内研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 14 名帕金森病患者接受重复阳极经颅直流电刺激（tDCS）的探索性研究显示，患者临床症状（UPDRS-III、NMSS-K 评分下降，MoCA-K 评分增加）和脑脊液代谢组学发生短期变化，包括嘌呤和酪氨酸/左旋多巴相关代谢物增加，以及非极性脂质改变。本研究缺乏安慰剂对照。
items.curatedReasonEn: This exploratory study offers the first insights into potential cerebrospinal fluid metabolomic changes following repeated transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS) in Parkinson's disease. While lacking a sham control, it provides crucial feasibility data and candidate molecular targets for future randomized controlled trials, helping you track advancements in non-invasive brain stimulation therapies.
items.limitation: 本研究为小样本探索性研究，缺乏安慰剂对照组，无法确定治疗的有效性和因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This small-sample exploratory study lacks a sham control group, preventing determination of treatment efficacy or causality.

items.title: The experiences of physiotherapists regarding self-management practices for patients with non-specific chronic low back pain, South Africa: A qualitative study.
items.summary: A qualitative study of 21 South African physiotherapists identified six themes regarding self-management for non-specific chronic low back pain, emphasizing the biopsychosocial model, patient beliefs, social factors, and interprofessional teamwork.
items.curatedReason: 对于非特异性慢性下腰痛的自我管理，这项针对 21 位南非物理治疗师的定性研究提示，需持续关注生物心理社会模型和患者信念。别忘了将社会因素和跨专业协作纳入你的临床考量，这可能有助于提升长期管理效果。
items.titleZh: 南非物理治疗师对非特异性慢性下腰痛患者自我管理实践的经验：一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对南非21名物理治疗师的定性研究，通过访谈识别了六个关于非特异性慢性下腰痛自我管理的主题，强调生物心理社会模型、患者信仰、社会因素和跨专业团队合作的重要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: For non-specific chronic low back pain self-management, this qualitative study of 21 South African physiotherapists suggests a continued focus on the biopsychosocial model and patient beliefs. Remember to integrate social factors and interprofessional teamwork into your clinical considerations, as this may improve long-term management outcomes.
items.limitation: 研究仅限于南非林波波省的21名物理治疗师，结果可能不完全适用于其他地区或文化背景。
items.limitationEn: The study was limited to 21 physiotherapists in the Limpopo province of South Africa, and its findings may not be fully generalizable to other regions or cultural contexts.
items.journal: The South African journal of physiotherapy

items.title: Validity and Reliability of Accelerometers to Evaluate Preschool-Aged Children’s Physical Activity and Sedentary Behavior During Free-Living Condition: A Systematic Review
items.summary: A systematic review found accelerometers to be valid and reliable for assessing physical activity in preschool-aged children in free-living conditions, but less reliable for sedentary behavior, with no clear pooled direction.
items.curatedReason: 评估儿童身体活动和久坐行为需要可靠工具。本系统综述发现，加速度计在学龄前儿童自由生活条件下，对身体活动评估的效度和信度较高，但对久坐行为的可靠性较低。在实际应用中，要根据具体目的选择合适的参数和监测部位。
items.titleZh: 加速度计评估学龄前儿童自由生活条件下身体活动和久坐行为的效度和信度：一项系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述发现，加速度计在学龄前儿童自由生活条件下评估身体活动具有较高的效度和信度，但在评估久坐行为方面可靠性较低，且未能报告汇总效应方向。
items.curatedReasonEn: Assessing physical activity and sedentary behavior in children requires reliable tools. This systematic review found that accelerometers have high validity and reliability for physical activity in preschool-aged children under free-living conditions, but lower reliability for sedentary behavior. Clinicians should select appropriate parameters and monitoring sites based on specific objectives.
items.limitation: 研究未提供荟萃分析结果，可能存在异质性。
items.limitationEn: The review did not report a pooled direction of effect and may have high heterogeneity.
items.journal: Measurement in Physical Education and Exercise Science

items.title: Movement matters: the path to professional impact.
items.summary: Christopher M. Powers, PT, PhD, FAPTA, the 57th McMillan Lecturer, is recognized for his leadership in human movement science and his research in lower-extremity biomechanics, contributing to evidence-based approaches for knee pain and sports injuries.
items.curatedReason: 本文介绍了 Christopher M. Powers 教授作为物理治疗领域的杰出贡献者。他长期深耕下肢生物力学及肌肉骨骼损伤领域，在膝关节疼痛和运动损伤的预防与治疗方面提供了循证方法。
items.titleZh: 运动至关重要：通向专业影响力的道路
items.summaryZh: 第 57 届 McMillan 讲师 Christopher M. Powers 教授因其在人体运动科学领域的领导力和在下肢生物力学研究方面的贡献而受到认可，其工作塑造了膝关节疼痛和运动损伤预防与治疗的循证方法。
items.curatedReasonEn: This article highlights Professor Christopher M. Powers as a distinguished contributor to physical therapy, recognized for his long-standing work in lower-extremity biomechanics and musculoskeletal injury. His contributions have shaped evidence-based approaches to preventing and treating knee pain and sports-related injuries.

items.title: Effects of Using High-Frequency TENS During an Exercise Therapy Program in Knee Osteoarthritis: A Randomized Sham-Controlled Trial.
items.summary: This sham-controlled RCT found that adding high-frequency transcutaneous electrical nerve stimulation to an exercise therapy program did not provide additional benefits for pain or function in 96 individuals with knee osteoarthritis (adjusted mean difference, 1.05 points; 95% CI, -5.19 to 7.29 for KOOS Pain subscale post-intervention).
items.curatedReason: 高频 TENS 对膝骨关节炎的运动疗法没有额外益处。如果你还在常规联用，这些数据提示是时候重新评估其必要性了。
items.titleZh: 高频 TENS 联合运动疗法治疗膝骨关节炎的疗效：一项随机假对照试验
items.summaryZh: 这项假对照随机对照试验发现，在运动疗法中加入高频经皮神经电刺激，对 96 例膝骨关节炎患者的疼痛或功能没有额外益处（干预后 KOOS 疼痛分量表调整平均差为 1.05 分；95% CI 为 -5.19 至 7.29）。
items.curatedReasonEn: High-frequency TENS offers no additional benefit when combined with exercise therapy for knee osteoarthritis. If you are routinely co-prescribing it, these data suggest it's time to re-evaluate its necessity.
items.limitation: 本研究缺少正式的盲法评估，随访期短，且缺乏单纯运动治疗组进行对比。
items.limitationEn: The study lacked formal blinding assessment, had a short follow-up, and did not include an exercise-only group for comparison.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Physical therapy care utilization and associated sociodemographic and clinical factors among noncommunicable diseases in the brazilian population: A cross-sectional, population-based study.
items.summary: A cross-sectional study using the 2019 National Health Survey database (n=88,531 Brazilians with NCDs) found that stroke survivors had the highest physical therapy utilization (17.0%; 95% CI: 15.4%, 18.7%). Follow-up by a healthcare professional was a common associated factor across stroke, chronic back pain, and chronic respiratory diseases.
items.curatedReason: 这次巴西的横断面研究提示，卒中幸存者的物理治疗利用率最高，达 17%。这表明医疗专业人员的持续随访可能直接影响慢性病患者获得治疗，值得我们在临床实践中加强随访策略。
items.titleZh: 巴西非传染性疾病人群物理治疗利用及其社会人口学和临床相关因素：一项横断面、基于人群的研究
items.summaryZh: 一项使用 2019 年国家健康调查数据库的横断面研究（88,531 名患有非传染性疾病的巴西人）发现，卒中幸存者的物理治疗利用率最高（17.0%；95% CI：15.4%, 18.7%）。由医疗专业人员随访是卒中、慢性背痛和慢性呼吸系统疾病患者共同的相关因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: This Brazilian cross-sectional study suggests stroke survivors have the highest PT utilization at 17%. This indicates that ongoing follow-up by a healthcare professional likely influences access to treatment for chronic conditions, underscoring the importance of strengthening follow-up strategies in clinical practice.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面调查的子分析，无法建立因果关系，且数据依赖于自我报告。
items.limitationEn: This is a sub-analysis of a cross-sectional survey, which cannot establish causality, and the data rely on self-reporting.

items.title: Identifying heterogeneous patterns of real-world upper limb use beyond motor severity: a cross-sectional sensor-based study in people with subacute stroke
items.summary: A cross-sectional study of 101 subacute stroke patients used accelerometers and FMA-UL to identify six heterogeneous upper limb activity patterns, distinguishing between motor deficits, learned non-use, and UL inattention. Clinical variables like ARAT, MAL, and UL inattention were key differentiators.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究利用传感器数据识别出卒中后上肢真实世界使用模式的六种亚型，远远超越了单纯的运动功能评分。这提醒你在临床评估时，不能只看 FMA-UL，还要结合 MAL、ARAT 和注意力评估，才能更精准地为亚急性期卒中患者制定个性化康复方案，尤其要警惕“习得性废用”和“上肢不注意”带来的影响。
items.titleZh: 亚急性卒中患者上肢真实世界使用模式的异质性识别：一项超越运动严重程度的基于传感器的横断面研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对101名亚急性卒中患者的横断面研究，利用加速度计和 Fugl-Meyer 上肢评估（FMA-UL），识别出六种异质性上肢活动模式，区分了运动缺陷、习得性废用和上肢不注意。Action Research Arm Test (ARAT)、Motor Activity Log (MAL) 和上肢不注意是区分不同集群的关键临床变量。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study used sensor data to identify six real-world upper limb use subtypes after stroke, going beyond motor severity scores. This highlights the need to combine FMA-UL with MAL, ARAT, and inattention assessments for precise, individualized rehabilitation in subacute stroke, particularly for learned non-use and UL inattention.
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面研究，无法追踪不同亚型随时间的演变，且样本量为101人，可能会限制亚型模式的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: This is a cross-sectional study, unable to track subtype evolution over time, and the sample size of 101 participants may limit the generalizability of the identified patterns.

items.title: Effects of cluster-set vs. traditional resistance exercise with equated total rest on muscular performance, perceived fatigue, and cardiovascular responses in resistance-trained women
items.summary: A crossover RCT with 12 resistance-trained women found that cluster-set configurations (10-s and 30-s intra-set rest) significantly improved muscular endurance (18.4 ± 1.7 reps for CLS30 vs. 12.8 ± 1.2 for TRS) and reduced perceived fatigue compared to traditional sets, with equated total rest.
items.curatedReason: 在总休息时间相同的前提下，集束组训练能显著提高抗阻训练女性的肌肉耐力表现并降低主观疲劳和心血管负荷工作比。这意味着你可以考虑在女性抗阻训练中引入集束组，尤其是在不希望增加总体休息时间，但又想优化表现和减少疲劳感时。
items.titleZh: 集束组与传统抗阻训练在总休息时间相等条件下对女性肌肉表现、疲劳感和心血管反应的影响
items.summaryZh: 一项对12名抗阻训练女性进行的交叉随机对照试验发现，在总休息时间相等的情况下，集束组训练（组间休息10秒和30秒）与传统组训练相比，显著提高了肌肉耐力（CLS30组为18.4 ± 1.7次，传统组为12.8 ± 1.2次）并降低了疲劳感。
items.curatedReasonEn: With equated total rest, cluster-set configurations significantly improve muscular endurance and reduce perceived fatigue and cardiovascular load-to-work ratios in resistance-trained women. This suggests you can consider implementing cluster-sets in women's resistance training, especially when optimizing performance and reducing fatigue without increasing overall rest time.
items.limitation: 研究样本量仅为12名女性，且仅评估了急性效应，长期适应性尚不明确。
items.limitationEn: The study involved only 12 women and assessed acute effects, so long-term adaptations are not yet clear.

items.title: The effects of route previewing on adaptive gait and gaze behaviour under cognitive dual-task conditions in older adults
items.summary: A study (n=39 older adults) found that route previewing before gait initiation attenuates the negative effects of cognitive load on adaptive gait, reducing stepping errors and cross-steps (p < .001) and improving gaze efficiency, likely by supporting visual motor planning.
items.curatedReason: 路线预演能有效缓解认知双任务情境下老年人适应性步态的负面影响，减少步态错误和交叉步，并改善注视行为。在对老年人进行步态训练时，将简单的视觉规划策略纳入干预方案，能显著提高他们在复杂环境中的行走安全性。
items.titleZh: 认知双任务条件下路线预演对老年人适应性步态和注视行为的影响
items.summaryZh: 一项研究（39 名老年人）发现，步态启动前的路线预演能减弱认知负荷对适应性步态的负面影响，减少步态错误和交叉步（p < .001），并提高注视效率，可能通过支持视觉运动规划实现。
items.curatedReasonEn: Route previewing effectively mitigates the negative impact of cognitive dual-task conditions on adaptive gait in older adults, reducing stepping errors and cross-steps, and improving gaze behavior. When conducting gait training for older adults, incorporating simple visual planning strategies into intervention programs can significantly enhance their walking safety in complex environments.
items.limitation: 研究仅评估了路线预演的即时效果，需要更长的随访来确认其长期效益和习惯性改变。
items.limitationEn: The study only assessed the immediate effects of route previewing; longer follow-up is needed to confirm its long-term benefits and habitual changes.

items.title: New Regulations Make It Easier to Find, Compare, and Report Healthcare Pricing and Coverage Information
items.summary: CMS announced new regulations aimed at increasing transparency in healthcare pricing and coverage information, making it easier for consumers to find, compare, and report such data.
items.curatedReason: 美国CMS发布新规，旨在提高医疗服务定价和保险覆盖信息的透明度，让消费者更容易查找、比较和报告。虽然不是直接针对PT执业的单项政策，但作为美国医疗系统普遍性的定价和报销流程变化，这将间接影响 PT 诊所的患者沟通和收费合规。
items.titleZh: 阅读更多关于新法规使得医疗定价和覆盖信息更容易查找、比较和报告
items.summaryZh: CMS 宣布新法规，旨在提高医疗定价和覆盖信息的透明度，让消费者更容易查找、比较和报告相关数据。
items.curatedReasonEn: CMS in the US has issued new regulations to enhance transparency in healthcare pricing and insurance coverage, making it easier for consumers to find, compare, and report information. While not a direct, single policy for PT practice, as a general change in the US healthcare system's pricing and reimbursement processes, this will indirectly affect PT clinics' patient communication and billing compliance.

items.title: "It's not for me": community-based fall prevention exercise programs for those aging into disability.
items.summary: A qualitative study (n=11) explored barriers for adults aged 50+ with self-reported mobility, vision, or hearing impairment participating in community-based fall prevention exercise programs. Themes included lack of awareness/access, interconnected barriers, disability experiences, and program design challenges, revealing that participants often don't identify with programs due to stigma and misalignment.
items.curatedReason: 该定性研究揭示了老年残障人士不愿参与社区跌倒预防项目的原因，主要在于感知到的污名和项目设计不适切。这提示我们在推广和设计此类项目时，应更注重包容性、灵活性和身份认同，以提高依从性。
items.titleZh: “不适合我”：针对“渐进性残疾”老年人的社区跌倒预防运动项目
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究（n=11）探讨了 50 岁及以上、自我报告有活动、视力或听力障碍的成年人参与社区跌倒预防运动项目的障碍。研究发现，由于污名化和项目错位，参与者常不认同这些项目。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study reveals why older adults with disabilities are reluctant to participate in community-based fall prevention programs, primarily due to perceived stigma and unsuitable program designs. This suggests that when promoting and designing such programs, greater emphasis should be placed on inclusivity, flexibility, and identity affirmation to improve adherence.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（n=11），且参与者为自我报告残障的社区居住老年人，可能限制了结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: The study's small sample size (n=11) and reliance on self-reported disability among community-dwelling older adults may limit the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Identifying Indicators of Advanced Levels of Clinical Competence in Musculoskeletal Physiotherapy: A Francophone Delphi Study
items.summary: A Francophone Delphi study (n=27 experts) identified 13 indicators of advanced clinical competence in musculoskeletal physiotherapy, with 10 achieving consensus on formulation. These indicators primarily reflected advanced clinical reasoning, such as real-time adaptation and decision-making under uncertainty, rather than standardized outcome attainment.
items.curatedReason: 这份Delphi研究（27位专家）提示，判断肌肉骨骼物理治疗师的高级临床能力，重点不在能否达到标准化结果，而在于临床推理的复杂性，比如不确定下的决策和实时应变能力。这意味着PT职业发展和晋升体系，应侧重评估这些进阶思维，而非仅仅是操作或结果达成。
items.titleZh: 识别肌肉骨骼物理治疗高级临床能力的指标：一项法语Delphi研究
items.summaryZh: 一项法语Delphi研究（27位专家）确定了肌肉骨骼物理治疗高级临床能力的 13 项指标，其中 10 项在表述上达成共识。这些指标主要反映高级临床推理，而非标准化结果。
items.curatedReasonEn: This Delphi study (27 experts) suggests that advanced musculoskeletal PT competence hinges on complex clinical reasoning, like decision-making under uncertainty and real-time adaptation, rather than just achieving standardized outcomes. For PT career advancement and evaluation, focus on assessing these higher-level cognitive skills, not just procedural proficiency or result attainment.
items.limitation: 研究仅限于法国讲法语的专家，可能限制了结果向其他文化或语言背景的物理治疗师的普适性。
items.limitationEn: The study was limited to French-speaking experts in France, which may restrict the generalizability of the findings to physical therapists in other cultural or linguistic contexts.

items.title: Immediate effects of suspension walker support on locomotor behavior of pre-walking infants with Down syndrome
items.summary: A study on pre-walking infants with Down syndrome (DS) (ages 10-19 months) found that suspension walkers robustly increased locomotor behavior, including upright time and stepping rate. Most walker movement was caregiver-initiated, and infants stepped more while the walker was moving.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究表明，即使没有长期练习，悬吊式助行器也能显著增加未习步的唐氏综合征婴儿的运动行为。这提示该设备在家用干预中的潜力，且强调了照护者在促进婴儿运动中的关键作用。
items.titleZh: 悬吊式助行器支撑对未习步唐氏综合征婴儿运动行为的即时影响
items.summaryZh: 一项针对未习步唐氏综合征（DS）婴儿（10-19个月）的研究发现，悬吊式助行器能显著增加其运动行为，包括直立时间和步进频率。多数助行器移动由照护者启动，且婴儿在助行器移动时步进更多。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study indicates that suspended walkers can significantly increase locomotor behavior in pre-walking infants with Down syndrome, even without prolonged practice. This highlights the device's potential for home-based interventions and emphasizes the crucial role of caregivers in promoting infant movement.
items.limitation: 研究缺乏对照组，且未评估助行器使用的长期效果或对自主行走能力发展的潜在影响。
items.limitationEn: The study lacked a control group and did not assess the long-term effects of walker use or its potential impact on the development of independent walking abilities.

items.title: Assessing frailty in lung transplantation candidates
items.summary: A study (n=82) comparing frailty assessment tools in lung transplantation candidates found SPPB showed better discrimination than SHARE-FI for COPD and interstitial lung disease (ILD). SPPB identified 4.9% frail and 15.9% pre-frail patients, while SHARE-FI identified 31.7% and 50% respectively. SHARE-FI may be appropriate as a preliminary screening instrument for ILD patients.
items.curatedReason: 在肺移植候选人中评估衰弱，SPPB工具在区分COPD和ILD患者方面优于SHARE-FI。这提示我们选择评估工具时需考虑特定肺部疾病类型，SPPB应作为此类患者衰弱评估的首选。
items.titleZh: 肺移植候选人的衰弱评估
items.summaryZh: 一项评估肺移植候选人衰弱的对照研究（n=82）发现，SPPB 在区分慢阻肺（COPD）和间质性肺病（ILD）患者方面优于 SHARE-FI。SPPB 识别出 4.9% 的衰弱和 15.9% 的衰弱前期患者，而 SHARE-FI 分别识别出 31.7% 和 50%。SHARE-FI 可能适用于 ILD 患者的初步筛查。
items.curatedReasonEn: In assessing frailty among lung transplantation candidates, the SPPB tool showed better discrimination than SHARE-FI for differentiating between COPD and ILD patients. This suggests that when selecting assessment tools, we need to consider specific lung disease types, and SPPB should be the preferred choice for frailty assessment in these patients.
items.limitation: 研究的受试者是等待肺移植的患者，结果可能不适用于其他疾病背景下的衰弱评估。
items.limitationEn: The study subjects were patients awaiting lung transplantation, and the results may not be applicable to frailty assessment in other disease contexts.

items.title: Transparency in Coverage Final Rules (CMS 9882-F)
items.summary: CMS provides information on the Transparency in Coverage Final Rules (CMS 9882-F), which mandate health insurance issuers and group health plans to disclose pricing information.
items.curatedReason: 这是一份关于美国联邦医疗保险与医疗补助服务中心（CMS）"透明度覆盖最终规则"的概况介绍。这些规则对保险公司和雇主健康计划的信息披露有直接要求，你应了解其潜在影响，尤其是对患者自付费用和报销机制的透明度。
items.titleZh: 阅读更多关于《透明度覆盖最终规则》（CMS 9882-F）
items.summaryZh: 美国联邦医疗保险与医疗补助服务中心（CMS）发布了《透明度覆盖最终规则》（CMS 9882-F）的更多信息，这些规则要求健康保险公司和团体健康计划披露定价信息。
items.curatedReasonEn: This is an overview of the CMS "Transparency in Coverage Final Rules." These rules directly mandate information disclosure from insurers and employer health plans; you should understand their potential impact, especially regarding patient out-of-pocket costs and reimbursement transparency.

items.title: [World Report] Barriers to care: how new immigration rules are reshaping the US health workforce
items.summary: Volatile US immigration rules are raising concerns about staffing health and social care across the USA, potentially impacting the physical therapy workforce.
items.curatedReason: 美国移民政策的波动性正在直接影响医疗和社会护理领域的劳动力供应。这可能导致物理治疗师在招聘、人员配置和跨州执业方面遇到新的挑战，直接影响你的执业环境。
items.titleZh: 护理障碍：新移民法规如何重塑美国医疗劳动力
items.summaryZh: 报道指出，美国多变且限制性的移民法规正引发对全国医疗和社会护理人员配置的担忧。
items.curatedReasonEn: The volatility of US immigration policies is directly impacting the healthcare and social care workforce supply. This may lead to new challenges for physical therapists in recruitment, staffing, and interstate practice, directly affecting your practice environment.

items.title: Effects of Somatosensory Interventions on Sensory, Motor, and Balance Functions in Individuals with Stroke: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 9 RCTs (330 participants) found that somatosensory interventions significantly improved Berg Balance Scale scores in stroke patients compared to conventional therapy, but no significant pooled effects were observed for upper limb motor function.
items.curatedReason: 体感干预对卒中后感觉、运动和平衡功能的潜在益处现在有了系统综述证据。虽然异质性高且长期数据不足，但对 Berg 平衡量表分数的显著改善提示我们可将特定体感训练纳入卒中康复方案，尤其是本体感觉训练。
items.titleZh: 体感干预对卒中患者感觉、运动和平衡功能的影响：一项系统综述和 Meta 分析
items.summaryZh: 一项纳入 9 项随机对照试验（330 名参与者）的系统综述和 Meta 分析发现，体感干预在卒中患者中显著改善了 Berg 平衡量表分数，但对上肢运动功能没有观察到显著的汇总效应。
items.curatedReasonEn: Systematic review evidence now suggests potential benefits of somatosensory interventions for sensory, motor, and balance functions post-stroke. While high heterogeneity and limited long-term data exist, significant improvements in Berg Balance Scale scores indicate that specific somatosensory training, particularly proprioceptive training, can be incorporated into stroke rehabilitation protocols.
items.limitation: 本系统综述纳入的随机对照试验存在异质性且方法学质量存在顾虑，缺乏长期随访数据。
items.limitationEn: This systematic review included heterogeneous RCTs with methodological concerns, and long-term follow-up data are lacking.

items.title: The effects of blood flow restriction training on lower limb motor function and balance in stroke patients: a randomized clinical trial.
items.summary: A 3-week regimen of blood flow restriction (BFR) walking or low-load BFR resistance training significantly improved lower limb motor function and balance in 96 stroke patients compared to conventional training, with 34.4% of LL-BFR participants achieving MCID for FMA-LE vs 15.6% in control.
items.curatedReason: 为卒中患者带来希望：结合常规康复，BFR 训练（无论是 BFR 步行还是低负荷抗阻训练）能在中短期内显著改善下肢运动功能和平衡。可以考虑将 BFR 作为常规方案的有力补充。
items.titleZh: 血流限制训练对卒中患者下肢运动功能和平衡的影响：一项随机临床试验
items.summaryZh: 一项对 96 名卒中患者进行的为期 3 周的随机对照试验显示，血流限制 (BFR) 步行或低负荷 BFR 抗阻训练方案显著改善了患者的下肢运动功能和平衡，其中 34.4% 的低负荷 BFR 组患者达到 FMA-LE 的最小临床重要差异，而对照组为 15.6%。
items.curatedReasonEn: For stroke patients, BFR training—either BFR-walking or low-load resistance training—significantly improves lower limb motor function and balance in the short to medium term when combined with conventional rehabilitation. Consider integrating BFR as a potent adjunct to standard protocols.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小，随访期仅 3 周，长期效果尚不明确。
items.limitationEn: The study has a relatively small sample size and a short 3-week follow-up, so long-term effects remain unclear.
